title: Reproduction Art
slide_intent: Show how a sender can remain identifiable down to a specific facility and address. The reader needs to distinguish agency, center and contact details in a compact block.
strategic_value: NASA can maintain a consistent signature while allowing the Kennedy Space Center to identify itself and supply return contact information.
demonstration: The two columns carry repeated John F. Kennedy Space Center lockups at descending sizes. Each adds center name, address and telephone information beneath the agency signature.
practical_value: Select a prepared center master at the required size to keep the local name, address and mark in their prescribed relationship.

content_islands.name: Production instructions
content_islands.spec: Place the title and instruction to use the shown sizes above the specimens.

content_islands.name: Center masters
content_islands.spec: Arrange the marked address blocks in paired columns and descending rows. Keep the center name prominent above its smaller address and telephone lines.
